resume: Chord instrument in the spirit of the Telepathic Orchid: one hand plays the roots, the other shapes the chords. It offers a Key mode, play modes, a bass and a looper, on the FM-1's sound engines.

commandes.role: Lowers the roots by one octave. In layers, menus and dialogs, goes back or cancels.
Raises the roots by one octave. In layers, menus and dialogs, confirms.
Tapped, turns the effects on or off. Held, opens the FX layer (SELECT chooses the page, KNOB 1 to 4 its cells).
Printed KEY in this firmware. Tapped, turns Key Mode on or off. Held, opens the KEY layer (tonic, scale).
Printed BASS in this firmware. Tapped, turns the bass on or off. Held, opens the BASS layer (behavior, register, sound, level).
Printed LOCK. Tapped, turns LOCK on or off, which keeps the pressed chord type. Held, opens the LOCK layer.
Opens the sound editor. Held, opens the engine selector.
Printed OPT. Opens the options (SELECT chooses the setting, KNOB 1 its value).
Goes back. On the view, goes to the next view. Held 0.6 s, opens the views menu.
Opens the save menu. Held, does the global save (everything, loop included).
Printed PERF. Tapped, turns the performance mode (strum, arpeggio, harp...) on or off. Held, opens its layer.
Opens the loop editor. Held, opens the metronome menu.
Printed LOOP. Starts and stops the loop. Held, opens the PLAY menu (slot, recording mode, length).
Records according to the chosen recording mode and ends the take. Held, undoes the last layer.
Tempo. In a layer, the layer's selector.
Chord block: DIM, MIN, MAJ on the black keys F#3, G#3, A#3 (G#3 and A#3 together: SUS), and 6, m7, M7, 9 on the white keys F3, G3, A3, B3. The roots run from C4 to G5. KNOB 1 sets the voicing.

gestes: OCT- and OCT+ together: PANIC, all notes off.
GLO held + PRESETS or ALGORITHM: changes the engine of the chord or bass sound.
